THE_SOLITARY_RELIC_SWIFT_CIRCUIT.title: Swift Circuit
THE_SOLITARY_RELIC_SWIFT_CIRCUIT.descrip: Add the [purple]Swift[/purple] [gold]enchantment[/gold] to the first [blue]{Cards}[/blue] cards you draw.
THE_SOLITARY_RELIC_SWIFT_CIRCUIT.flavor: The details of this relic will be revealed in the future…….
THE_SOLITARY_RELIC_RAPID_CIRCUIT.title: Rapid Circuit
THE_SOLITARY_RELIC_RAPID_CIRCUIT.descrip: Add the [purple]Swift[/purple] [gold]enchantment[/gold] ×{SwiftAmount} to the first [blue]{Cards}[/blue] cards you draw.
THE_SOLITARY_RELIC_RAPID_CIRCUIT.flavor: The circuit hums with twice the arcane charge, urging every card into overdrive.
THE_SOLITARY_RELIC_ARCANE_AEGIS.title: Arcane Aegis
THE_SOLITARY_RELIC_ARCANE_AEGIS.flavor: Arts woven into a shield, turning each incantation into a line of defense.
THE_SOLITARY_RELIC_BACK_AND_FORTH.title: Back and Forth
THE_SOLITARY_RELIC_BACK_AND_FORTH.descri: Whenever you shuffle, add a random [gold]Art[/gold] to your hand.
THE_SOLITARY_RELIC_BACK_AND_FORTH.flavor: Fate weaves back and forth like a shuttle on a loom.
THE_SOLITARY_RELIC_ARCANE_SETTLING.title: Arcane Settling
THE_SOLITARY_RELIC_ARCANE_SETTLING.descr: The first time you [gold]Enchant[/gold] a card each turn, gain [blue]{Block:diff()}[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
THE_SOLITARY_RELIC_ARCANE_SETTLING.flavo: Stray arcana settles into an unbreakable bulwark.
THE_SOLITARY_RELIC_SAPPING_FORMATION.des: At the start of each combat, ALL enemies lose {StrengthPower:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold] and {DexterityPower:diff()} [gold]Dexterity[/gold].
THE_SOLITARY_RELIC_SAPPING_FORMATION.fla: When the formation rises, even the fiercest foe grows listless.
THE_SOLITARY_RELIC_ARCANE_SYMPATHY.title: Arcane Sympathy
THE_SOLITARY_RELIC_ARCANE_SYMPATHY.descr: Every {Cards:diff()} [gold]Arts[/gold] you play, randomly [gold]Enchant[/gold] a card in your hand.
THE_SOLITARY_RELIC_ARCANE_SYMPATHY.flavo: Art and primal energy commune, echoing through every incantation.
THE_SOLITARY_RELIC_ARCANE_CORE.title: Arcane Core
THE_SOLITARY_RELIC_ARCANE_CORE.flavor: A burning core of arcana that fuels every enchantment it touches.
THE_SOLITARY_RELIC_FOUR_SYMBOLS_FORMATIO: In each combat, after you play four different [gold]Arts[/gold], ALL enemies lose {StrengthPower:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold] and {DexterityPower:diff()} [gold]Dexterity[/gold].
Azure Dragon, Vermilion Bird, White Tiger, Black Tortoise—the four symbols command the field.
